title: The ECSS package of SPSCring: what it holds and how it maps to the rms
body: The package's overview: the customer and the supplier, the documents and their reviews, the items as CSVs in the rms import format, the references, the open items.
rationale: One page says where every document and item of SPSCRING comes from.
criteria: The review of the milestone accepts it.

title: Tailoring statement and criticality classification
body: Category C proposed from kyr_host's use, the tailoring of ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2 for a one-file C library, the document set and its reviews.
rationale: ECSS-Q-ST-80 6.2.2 (software criticality); ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex R and Annex S.
criteria: The SRR accepts the proposal; the customer confirms the category.

title: Software system specification (SSS): what the platform requires of the ring
body: The customer's requirements on the software, as the platform states them from kyr_host's use: the hand-off of an accepted connection, never blocking the listener, the bounded capacity, the delivery.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2: the requirements baseline is the customer's output.
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
notes: file=RB; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex B; reviews=SRR; path=ecss/RB/SSS.md

title: Interface requirements document (IRD) toward SPSCring
body: The interface the platform requires of the ring: the C calls kyr_host makes, their statuses, the thread roles, the publication order, the linkage.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2.4.3a: the interface requirements are the customer's output, part of the requirements baseline.
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
notes: file=RB; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex C; reviews=SRR; path=ecss/RB/IRD.md

title: Statement of work: the ring for the platform
body: What the platform asks of the supplier: the library, its documents after ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2, the reviews SRR to QR, the release pinned by the platform.
rationale: The contract's part of the requirements baseline (ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2).
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.

title: Software requirements specification (SRS)
body: The supplier's requirements of SPSCring 1.0.8: creation, capacity, order, refusal, memory ordering, wait-freedom, lock-free atomics, queries, delivery; each derived from the requirements baseline.
criteria: The document follows its DRD section by section; the PDR accepts it.
notes: file=TS; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex D; reviews=PDR; path=ecss/TS/SRS.md

title: Interface control document (ICD)
body: The library's interface toward kyr_host and every consumer: the header's type and nine functions, the build-time switches, the shared object's soname and exports, the packages.
criteria: The document follows its DRD section by section; the PDR accepts it.
notes: file=TS; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex E; reviews=PDR; path=ecss/TS/ICD.md

title: Software design document (SDD)
body: The design of app/spscring.c: the control block and its cache lines, creation and teardown, the producer side, the consumer side, the queries, the test seams; the decisions and their reasons; the diagrams.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the PDR accepts the architecture.
notes: file=DDF; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex F; reviews=PDR,CDR; path=ecss/DDF/SDD.md

title: API reference of spscring.h (from the code, by Doxygen)
body: Every type and function of app/spscring.h with its parameters, returns, thread-safety notes and the tests that call it, written from Doxygen's XML of the release commit; the call, caller and include graphs beside it.
rationale: The header is the interface; its reference is generated from it so that the two never differ.
criteria: Generated from the release commit; the CDR accepts it.

title: Software user manual (SUM)
body: How a consumer builds against SPSCring, creates a ring, hands values from one producer to one consumer, handles a full or an empty ring and tears the ring down; the errors and what to do.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the CDR accepts it.
notes: file=DDF; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex H; reviews=CDR; path=ecss/DDF/SUM.md

title: Software validation specification w.r.t. the TS (SVS)
body: The cases: the release pipeline's suites and gates grouped by what they prove, the inspection of the memory ordering, each with its criteria and the requirements it verifies.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the CDR accepts it.
notes: file=DJF; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex L; reviews=CDR; path=ecss/DJF/SVS.md

title: Software verification report (SVR)
body: The release pipeline run at 0ad84dc1 (1.0.8): every stage, every suite's count, the coverage, the stress figures, the evidence logs; what was not run and why; the verification status of each requirement.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the QR accepts it.
notes: file=DJF; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex M; reviews=QR; path=ecss/DJF/SVR.md
